6223.title: Plugin pane URL decoding
6223.rootCauseOneLine: Both host pathname-to-pane parsers retain URL-encoded plugin wildcard text, which the route builder escapes again.
6223.proposedFix: Decode matched plugin route parameters once and reuse the parser at both host boundaries; keep URL building unchanged.
6223.caveats: Direct source and jsdom route reproduction; the reported macOS installation and third-party plugin were not exercised. Complete regression code and relevant output are inline under reports repository policy.
